scripts.dev: node --input-type=module -e "import http from 'node:http'; import worker from './src/index.js'; http.createServer(async (req,res)=>{try{const r=await worker.fetch(new Request(new URL(req.url,'http://localhost:8787'),{method:req.method}),{});res.writeHead(r.status,Object.fromEntries(r.headers));res.end(Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer()));}catch(e){console.error(e);res.writeHead(500);res.end('Local server error');}}).listen(8787,'0.0.0.0',()=>console.log('Preview: http://localhost:8787'));"
